item.title: World’s largest battery-electric ship enters harbor trials
item.description: Earlier this month on Hobart’s River Derwent, a 130-meter (426-ft) vessel began moving with an unfamiliar level of calm. No engine rumble, no exhaust plume; just the quiet churn of waterjets as Hull 096 eased away under its own power for the first time. Developed and built by Incat Tasmania, the ship has now entered its harbor trials: the first time it’s operated solely on battery-electric propulsion.Continue ReadingCategory: Marine, TransportTags: Electric Boats, Shipping, Batteries, World's La

item.description: Options in the world of flashlights for outdoorspeople are plentiful, but this one caught my eye with its unique build and handy features. item.title: Striking mini-supercar draws on Italian heritage – and boat design
item.description: The Bertone Runabout has familiar performance credentials, features, and price tag – but its unique lines were penned after extensive study of the hull shapes of modern speedboats.
